items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Her parents had been supporters of Sacco and Vanzetti.

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m the only person who’s been married three times and the last one will reach it’s fiftieth year, I think, next year. That’s part of the surprises of longevity, I guess. The first wife I got to know [as] part of a jazz circle in Boston. Her parents had been supporters of Sacco and Vanzetti. The father was a Unitarian preacher, so you know where the politics were there. The second wife . . .
Can you explain that? Because I’m not sure that a lot of people will know where the politics were for a Unitarian preacher in 1927.
